fee_notes: Royalty is tiered: 7% on Gross Revenue up to $35,000; 6% on $35,001-$75,000; 5% above $75,001; plus 5.0% of Brokerage Revenue. Minimum monthly royalty: $350 through month 23, $700 months 24-35, $1,050 from month 36+. Local Advertising minimum $2,000/month per primary pillar plus $1,000/month per additional pillar starting month 13.
raw_excerpt: Royalty: Monthly: (i) 5.0% of Brokerage Revenue plus (ii) a tiered percentage of Gross Revenue...7% on Gross Revenue up to $35,000, 6% on Gross Revenue from $35,001 to $75,000, and 5% on Gross Revenue above $75,001. National Marketing Fund: 2.0% of Gross Revenue.
